install_note: Python packages go in their own environment at ~/.venvs/colorgrade, never in the bot's .venv: python3 -m venv ~/.venvs/colorgrade && ~/.venvs/colorgrade/bin/pip install numpy pillow scipy scenedetect opencv-python-headless (about 300 MB). Licences: numpy BSD-3, scipy BSD-3, pillow MIT-CMU, PySceneDetect BSD-3, OpenCV Apache-2.0. All clean for paid client work. The object isolation track additionally wants DaVinci Resolve installed to receive the DCTL, but the DCTL is written and proved with no Resolve involved. The frame REBUILD in track three is the only part that needs torch and RIFE 4.25 (Practical-RIFE, MIT, weights from gpanaretou/practical-rife-interpolation on HuggingFace, about 80 MB): run scripts/setup_rife.sh. Stall detection, the cadence test, judder, the split screen tools and every colour tool work without it.
